scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because the PREN values derive from CALPHAD equilibrium compositions that cannot be recomputed in the verifier (requires thermodynamic database and solver). T3 structural checks (monotonic trends, crossing, and location of minimum difference) are the robust, re-derivable signature of the paper's main result.

outputs.description: CSV containing one row per phase per solution temperature; used to verify the physical consistency of the computed PREN values.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier will check the physical consistency of the PREN trends rather than comparing to a specific gold value. The load‑bearing flag on step 2 links it to the process step.
